translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yuda Ŋei Ŋetneŋo Yesu Qesonka Rakoi, “Ge maŋo Biragange”

Kaiwe maneo, Yesu eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo okora more, ŋei ŋerep magu biŋek don edange, pakiso Anutu wane mosop ŋei suaine ŋetne so Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Skribe, so Yuda ŋei suaine eŋe sari,
Yesu qesonka rakoi, “Ge yatne Anutu wane Bakom Urum koto qole qole ŋei esoponine, ea maŋo ra golatki okanine? Ge maŋo biragange?”
Yesu eŋe yale waka mainge edange, “Na yaleka ŋine qeso qeson weku qesonŋunbe, nolatpi.
Yohane doku tau tau wane urata, ea qeliwo ŋine wakonge, me ŋeiwo ŋine wakonge?”
Eŋe yale ra qesonongi, eŋe dere more eŋe edomka sorin nagukoi, “Daleo raikene? Ŋene raikene, ‘Ea Anutu wano ŋine wakonge,’ yale ra olatŋem, eŋe rayake, ‘Ŋine onoka wane ea mi dere malipkakoi.’
Ŋo, ŋene raikene, ‘Ea ŋeiwo ŋine wakonge,’ eamo ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe mo detmami, Yohane eŋe Anutu wane qelit ŋei mane, ea wane ŋene wesiŋo ŋenguwi seukkene.”
Ea wane, eŋe don iwa yale mainge olatkoi, “Yohane wane urata ea diao ŋine wakonge, ŋene mi detmaine.”
Eŋe yale rauso, Yesuŋo edange, “Na yalewaka maŋo nolatki okanile, ea na maine mi ŋidanikale.”
Wain Eu Wane Don Rokop
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe don rokop iwa yale edane rake, “Naso maneo, ŋei maneŋo wain eu ebore, eu yewa ŋei natne eŋane meteeno motki, edo urata yewa ware mageu, eŋine ea qelige lobo kepe amaŋ yewao ari geke.

Yewa ari geki wain wele menagi, eu welaine eŋe qelit medepine mane birakaki, eu ware warekoune eŋano ariki, eŋe wele natne manbi, ma sariakane arike. Ŋo eu ware ware eŋe wie qelit medep yewa malipka kiŋ quŋ qe esopkau, eŋe zinge yaup metineka arike.
Arikiso, eu welaine eŋe qelit medep mane koso birakaki sariki, ea eŋe yalewaka manerop matalika esopkau, eŋe zinge metineka arike.
Pakiso, eŋe soringe, koso qelit medep mane birakaki ariki, eŋe koso ziwem qe esopkakoi.
Pakiso, eu welaine eŋe rake, ‘Na dalino okanikale? Na siluŋ koso giponane wekuku wemedep iwa birakaikale, eŋe naŋane medep nae kotoo ŋine, ea wane aŋaine maine teweke more ewine kitokei!’

Ŋo eu ware ware ŋei eŋe medep yewa ka more, auye rakoi, ‘Medep yewa eŋe ge mage, magainane eu iwa ŋebu ma more, ea wane welaine okane wareoniake, ea wane ŋene qeŋem seukkiso, ŋedo eu iwa wane welaine okane warekene.’
Ea wane eŋe ma more euo esopka ari mage qeu seukke.” Yesu eŋe raki qoeki, qesonone rake, “Pakimo eu welaine eŋe ware ware ea korop daleo okanoniake?
Eŋe sari eu ware ware yewa korop enguki seukwarekei. Pakimo eŋe koso eu ware ware musele ma wakone biraoniake.” Ŋei ŋerep eŋe don ea dere more rakoi, “Eŋe masi yale mi mayake, midakaka!”
Yesuŋo eŋano lolike pore more, qesonone rake, “Ŋine Anutu wane papia iwa wane kine mi detlukkamami,

content.text: ‘Mat mama urata ŋei eŋe mat wane bosiŋ mane ea edo pelekine ra more, qikka more yeine birakoi, wane ŋado Anutuŋo bosiŋ ea maki mat wane banega bosiŋ togogole mane okange.’

content: Na ŋidanmaile, ŋei maneŋo banega bosiŋ ea wane kutno ket rasuyakeo, eŋane solaine korop sisi sisi kitatwareake, so bosiŋ eaŋo ŋei mane kutno kesiakeo, eŋe rasu pelelekki siukeake.”
Ŋei Edo Roma Kepe Ware Ware Suaine Takis Manikei Wane Yesu Qesonkakoi

Yesu eŋe yale ra edangi qoekiso, Anutu wane mosop ŋei suaine ŋetne so Anutu wane papa togon don wane welaine ŋei, eŋe Yesu malipka wokom kaikei wane okangoi, ea mo eŋe detpi, Yesu eŋe don rokop ea eŋano more rake, ea wane. Ŋo ŋei ŋerep eŋe Yesu wane don dere siminonge, yewa wane Yuda ŋei ŋetne eŋe kaetongi, Yesu qeliŋkakoi.

Yuda ŋei ŋetne eŋe sotene osike, paki eŋe numa mane maratka more, Yesu liewkkaikei wane zuangoi. Eŋe yale okane ŋei natne wesi ebone more edangoi, “Ŋine Yesu wano ari qeso qeson isisine liwek kaikei wane arikei.” Eŋe Yesu Roma kepe ware ware suainane, ŋei waom Yuda kepeo geke, eŋane meteo birakaikei wane okangoi.

Ŋei isisine eaŋo Yesu wano ari olatkoi, “Kito ebo ebon, ŋene ge detganmaine. Ge ŋei ŋerep koboboine kito edanmaine. Ge ŋei mane wane mi kaetgan okanmaike. Ge ŋei ŋerep natne don mane edane more, ŋei ŋerep magu natne mane mi edane okanmaine. Ge don wele so Anutu wane masi koboboine ŋei ŋerep korop sikanon okanmaine.
Ŋenze ra rokop donze ea wane ge dalino detmaine? Maine ŋene takis Roma kepe ware ware suaine manikene, me mida?”
Ŋo Yesu eŋe isisiene ea mo detone more, edane rake,
“Ŋine wesi yewa mane ma sari sikannanikei.” Yesuŋo wesi ea ka more qesononge, “Oŋa oŋa wesi solaino iwa so eŋet iwa maŋane?” Eŋe rakoi, “Kepe ware ware suaine, Sisa eŋane!”
Pakimo, Yesuŋo eŋane donene mainge rake, “Ŋine kepe ware ware suainane kine kine biŋek ea maine eŋe eŋine manikei. Ŋo, Anutu wane biŋek kine kine ea maine Anutu eŋe eŋine manikei.”
Yewao ŋei ŋerep eŋane kaitko, Yuda ŋei ŋetne eŋe koso maine mi liwek kakoi, eŋe yeine oŋaene qaekiso, mepene qoeki metkoi.
Ŋei Edo Ŋei Seu Seuo Ŋine Wisikae Wie Wie Ea Wane Yesu Qesonkakoi
Sadusi natne eŋe Yesu wano sarikoi, tego yewa eŋe ra okangoi, ŋei seu seune eŋe koso mi wisikae wiekei, ea wane eŋe Yesu qesonka rakoi,

“Kito ebo ebon, Moseŋo don mane iwa yale qeke, ‘Ŋei mane eŋe seukkeake, eŋe medeune midaine, ŋo, ŋanomine eŋe yeka geake, pakimo, ŋei seukke eŋane ŋole eŋe tatine qesiŋka more, ŋerep yewa oŋo koso ma more, medep mane tatinane tungo geakane ma wakoniake.’
Ŋenane dogisi iwa detnom, naso maneo, tatiŋon 7 yale eŋe gekoi, wane tatene suaine eŋe ŋerep mage more, medep mane mi ma wakone more, eŋe yaupka seukke.
Pakimo, ŋole kebaŋine oŋo tatinane mala ea make, eŋe yaleka medep mane mi ma wakone more, eŋe yaupka seukke.
Pakimo, ŋole ŋorikine eŋe yalewaka okange, yalewaka tatiŋon 7 yewa eŋe ŋerep yewa makoi, ŋo medep mane mi ma wakone more, eŋe yaup seukwarekoi.
Pakimo, ŋerep yewa eŋe yalewaka boaŋ ŋado ge mage more seukke.
Ea wane boaŋ ŋei seu seune eŋe wisikae wiekei, naso yewao ŋerep yewa eŋe maŋane ŋerep biŋek okaniake? Ŋei tatiŋone 7 eŋe ŋanomene weku yewa makoi.”
Yesu eŋe don kisi dere more mainge edange, “Kepo naso iwao, ŋei so ŋerep eŋe ŋao ŋanom gemami,
ŋo ŋei so ŋerep koboine okanmami, Anutuŋo eŋe deŋesereo ŋine maki wisikae wiekei, naso yewao, eŋe koso ŋao ŋanom mi gekei.
Eŋe qeliwo aŋelo yale gekei, eŋe maine mi seukkei, Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerep ea deŋesereo ŋine maki wisikae wiekei, naso eao eŋe Anutu wane medewekoune okanikei.

Ŋei seu seune eŋe wisikae wiekei, eŋane don mo Moseŋo kibiwo qeke eaŋo sikanŋonmaike, eki nigatne zeke, naso yewao Waom Anutu wane iwa yale ra more qeke, ‘Eŋe Abraham wane Anutu, so Isak wane Anutu, so Yakop wane Anutu gemaike.
Anutu eŋe ŋei wisika gemami, eŋane Anutu, eŋane deo ŋei ŋerep eŋe korop ge waremami. Eŋe ŋei seuseune eŋane midakaka.”
Yale rakiso Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei natne, Skribe, eŋe olatkoi, “Kito ŋebo ŋebon, ge don ea wekumane ramaine!”
Ŋo Sadusi eŋe zonomene midaki kaet okane more eŋe koso qeso qeson mane mi qesonkakoi.
Yesu Eŋe Ŋei Ŋerep Mesia Wane Edange
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe ŋei ŋerep qesonone rake, “Ŋei natne eŋe dalino Mesia wane ramami, eŋe Dawit wane ŋaboine kepeo ŋineka?
Dawit oŋomka Sam papiao qeke,

content.text: ‘Anutu Magak Suaineŋo naŋane suaine Mesia iwa yale olatke, ge naŋane wonnoken mesikene,
ŋado noŋo geŋane ŋabakopŋone, eŋe ea biraonbe, geŋane kieŋonane bano mesikei.’

content: Dawit oŋom Mesia iwa yale orake, ‘Naŋane Waom suaine,’ ŋo, ŋei natne naso iwao gemami, eŋe ra okanmami, Mesia eŋe Dawit wane ŋaboine kepeo ŋineka. Mi kopkemaike! Kristo eŋe Dawit wane ŋaboine so Anutu wane gipole weneŋ.”
Yesu Eŋe Anutu Papa Togon Welaine Ŋei Skribe Eŋane Girem Don Yale Ra More Dokoine Edange
Ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe Yesu wane don dere metpiso, Yesu eŋe zinge dokoine edange,

“Ŋine Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Skribe, eŋane kaulukkei. Eŋe takot kiroine kibinerop bira more arikei wane siminon okanmaike. Eŋe lewa lewaŋ sobego geu ŋei ŋerep edo one mawa one more, eweene kitou ge okanmami, ea siminonmaike. So epa kebu eao, so Yuda lewa lewaŋ urum koto eŋe metmet ŋetno mesikei wane okanmami.

Yale okane more, ŋerep mala isione more, eŋane mat omaon okanmaŋkei. Omaone more, eŋe ari Anutu wane Bakom Urum koto ŋei ŋerep eŋane deo okora, Anutu wano meŋe meŋen kiroroine meŋenka okanmaŋkei. Ŋei yaline yewa eŋe ge mage ŋado Anutuŋo wikile suaine eboniake.”
